headline: 138 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Timber Fire in CA, threatening 775 structures.

active_threats.name: Timber
active_threats.narrative: The Timber Fire in Monterey County, CA has burned 25,426 acres and is 39% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **775 structures threatened**. 1,348 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 27 mph, sustained near 14) with humidity as low as 21%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (NE) is not currently aligned toward Carmel Valley Village CDP, the nearest community of size, 20 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over TX: Lubbock city, Abilene city, Wichita Falls city, Plainview city, and Sweetwater city and 20 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2,3). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 7% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
